name: whizz-desktop
author: Whizz
description: Whizz desktop app — a native window around the Whizz web app, with a bounded set of CRUD features (leads, sales invoices, segments, country-language map, conversions) kept usable offline via a local SQLite mirror + sync queue. Everything else (sending WhatsApp/Telegram/email, live conversations, the Sales/ERP live pull, Lead Intelligence) stays online-only, same as the website.
